worldcombat.skill.temperflare.summary: When the last attack whiffed, hold nothing back: set yourself alight and ram the target, exploding on contact and scorching everyone nearby; if your previous move failed, this ram doubles and what it hits catches fire.
worldcombat.skill.temperflare.use.0: Answer a whiff by burning yourself into a charge
worldcombat.skill.temperflare.use.1: Explode at the impact point and sear the crowd
worldcombat.skill.temperflare.use.2: Set the struck target alight and char the ground
worldcombat.skill.temperflare.descriptio: Ram the target wreathed in flame for %1$s physical (Fire) power.
On impact a %2$s-block blaze splashes %1$s physical power onto other nearby enemies and shoves them %3$s blocks away.
The charge covers %1$s blocks at %2$s per tick; carrying the desperation, the struck catch fire for %3$s and the ground char lingers %4$s across %5$s cells.
worldcombat.skill.temperflare.reckless.o: Current: Reckless — charge farther and faster with a bigger blaze, but the ram is looser and the recovery and cooldown are longer.
Current: Controlled — a short, tight charge that recovers cleanly and hits harder once.
worldcombat.skill.temperflare.timing: Range %1$s blocks, prepare %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.temperflare.growth.0: At level %1$s the ram power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.temperflare.growth.1: At level %1$s the ram power rises to %2$s and the blaze to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.temperflare.preference: On: charge farther x1.15, faster x1.08 and a blaze x1.2 to chase a fleeing target, but the ram is looser x0.95, +3 recover and +8 cooldown. Off: a short, tight charge that recovers cleanly.
Only charge when the target is within this distance; raise it to chase farther targets.
On: right after a missed attack, prioritise the doubled ram; off: rank it as an ordinary melee move.
